nav.agents.tip: Open agent/rule documents in the right pane
nav.skills.tip: Open the SKILL.md list in the right pane
nav.manual.tip: Open the manual site (docs/) in the center pane
nav.settings.tip: Open watched-repository settings in the center pane

nav.push.tip: Push commits of the current repo to remote
git.pushConfirm: Push commits of {slug} to remote. Continue?
grip.left.tip: Drag to resize the left pane
grip.right.tip: Drag to resize the right pane
head.latest.tip: Show the chat with the latest updatedAt
view.dir.tip: Toggle the diagram direction vertical/horizontal (display only; file unchanged)
view.zoomOut.tip: Zoom out (wheel over the diagram also works)
view.zoomIn.tip: Zoom in (wheel over the diagram also works)
head.toIssue.tip: Register this conversation as an issue candidate
head.restore.tip: Revert files changed by this chat to a selected point (also works after session restore)
head.reset.tip: Fold the session; the next send starts a new one
chat.hintStart: Enter instructions to start an AI session
chat.hintStartAgent: Enter instructions to start a {agent} session
repoask.switch.tip: Switch the chat's repo/cwd to the candidate and resend the held request there
repoask.keep.tip: Resend with the current repo (this chat will not ask about this candidate again)
repoask.text: This looks intended for {slug}{reason}. Current repo: {repo} — switch?
input.placeholder: Enter instructions (Enter to send / Shift+Enter for newline / extra instructions while running also OK)
input.hint: Attachments can be pasted or picked. Sending while running adds a steer instruction. The last send can be revised with ↑ or ✎.
input.reviseHint: Revise mode: sending undoes the previous send and retries (Esc to cancel)
exmode.tip: Processing mode: direct=sequential as before / parallel=split the issue and auto-start child chats for deeper per-chat work
dirpick.title: Select folder
sess.resumable: ACP disconnected; resumes on next send
plink.child.tip: Child chat of a split task

Restore to which point? (enter a number / blank = latest only)

board.closeAll.tip: Delete all chats in the Done column
board.closeAll.confirm: Delete all {count} chats in the Done column?
board.resume.tip: Reconnect via session/load (no need to wait for the next send)
board.repoWait: Waiting for repo confirmation: candidate to switch → {slug}
settings.title: Settings
repo.regNote: slug is inferred from the git remote when omitted. Unregistered IDE-managed repos can also be added via "Add to watch list" on each card
agent.label: Label
agent.regNote: Register an AI connection. type: acp=ACP-capable CLI / agent=Canvas-compatible /agent protocol (bridge-hub :8511, external agents) / openai=OpenAI-compatible API. The active agent handles new chats (existing chats keep their creation-time agent). token is saved to secrets.json tokens (never written to config)
sys.title: System
sys.restart.tip: Restart control (deferred until busy chats finish)
sys.restartForce.tip: Abort running/waiting chats and restart immediately
sys.restartNote: Deferred while busy/waiting chats remain. Force aborts running chats and restarts immediately
banner.pending: Restart of control deferred (waiting for running chats)…
confirm.restartForce: Abort running/waiting chats and restart control.mjs now. Continue?
